steps.message: Execute: adb shell "pm list packages | grep -i stopwatch; pm list packages | grep -i clock; pm list packages | grep -i timer"

arguments.command: python android_env.py adb "adb shell "pm list packages | grep -i stopwatch; pm list packages | grep -i clock; pm list packages | grep -i timer""

steps.message: Execute: adb shell "am start -n com.google.android.deskclock/com.android.deskclock.DeskClock --activity-brought-to-front; sleep 1; am broadcast -a com.android.deskclock.action.START_STOPWATCH"

arguments.command: python android_env.py adb "adb shell "am start -n com.google.android.deskclock/com.android.deskclock.DeskClock --activity-brought-to-front; sleep 1; am broadcast -a com.android.deskclock.action.START_STOPWATCH""

steps.message: Execute: adb shell "dumpsys activity broadcasts | grep -i stopwatch; am start -a com.android.deskclock.action.START_STOPWATCH -n com.google.android.deskclock/com.android.deskclock.HandleApiCalls"
